## Projects

### Software & Full-Stack Applications
1. **SocietyCook** — Neighbours in the same apartment tower can book a cook together, split the cost, and schedule dishwashing after the meal. (React, Node.js, MySQL, TiDB) · Live: https://societycook.vercel.app · Repo: https://github.com/9harshithp/SocietyCook
2. **DearHand** — Families in Mysuru can book someone to accompany a parent to a hospital visit or pick up a prescription. (Java, Spring Boot, React, Razorpay) · Repo: https://github.com/9harshithp/DearHand
3. **BugLens v2.0** — Scores a bug report out of 100 and shows which details a developer still needs to reproduce it. (TypeScript, Express, PostgreSQL, Anthropic) · Live: https://buglens-2be.pages.dev/ · Repo: https://github.com/9harshithp/BugLens-Defect-Quality-Checker
4. **Pharmasure** — Pharmacy prototype that reads prescription text, tracks medicine batches, and flags stock approaching expiry. (React, Spring Boot, Gemini, MySQL) · Live: https://pharmasure.vercel.app/ · Repo: https://github.com/9harshithp/Pharmasure
5. **Talent Tuition Center** — Next.js preview for a Bengaluru tuition centre with separate student, teacher, and admin screens. (Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Gemini) · Live: https://talent-tuition-center.vercel.app/ · Repo: https://github.com/9harshithp/talent-tuition-center
6. **Desiri Naturals** — Grocery storefront where shoppers check delivery by pincode, order farm produce, and download an invoice. (React 19, Express 5, Drizzle, PostgreSQL) · Live: https://desiri-naturals-km63.vercel.app/ · Repo: https://github.com/9harshithp/Desiri-Naturals

### Game Development (PixiJS)
7. **Paperly** — Steer a paper plane through mountain valleys, boost through rings, and build a flight log across 15 chapters. (PixiJS, Flight controls, Chapter progression) · Repo: https://github.com/9harshithp/Paperly
8. **Ridgeline Rally** — Drive a stunt quad over rolling terrain, collect coins, and manage fuel while chasing your best distance. (PixiJS, Vehicle controls, 2D terrain) · Repo: https://github.com/9harshithp/ridgeline-rally
